notes: Run of 2026-11-20. Five Standard stories queued. Two earn entries: Lady Falcon Coffee's roastery opening at 3620 Wawona Street (the original reporting, which Hoodline relayed), and Alo Yoga's permit filing for a store at 170–180 Post Street. The Julius Castle review is a second account of the reopening already on that page; the transfer-tax and Anthropic stories print no address.

findings.description: Lady Falcon Coffee Club opens a roastery and bean shop in the small Wawona Street building near Ocean Beach that was the original home of Wise Surfboards (1969, per the Standard).

extra.relayed_by: Hoodline, “Lady Falcon Coffee Opens Outer Sunset Roastery in a Former Surf Shop,” 19 November 2026 (declined as a relay)

citation.label: The San Francisco Standard, “‘I have to love it’: Lady Falcon opens a coffee roastery in a former surf shop,” 19 November 2026

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 3620 WAWONA ST → parcel 2449025; sf-parcels has blklot 2449025 active, 3620–3620 WAWONA; the 2025 roll records it as commercial retail, built 1946.
resolution.note: No page at this path yet; the parcel is the publisher's to seed.

publish.note: Page seeded (research/manifests/news-2026-11-20.json); dated the opening day the story gives, Friday 20 November. Wise Surfboards' tenancy is left in extra: the Standard and Hoodline give different years.

findings.description: Alo Yoga filed permits to alter the exteriors of 170 and 180 Post Street for a new Union Square store, in a building bought this summer for $48.5 million.

extra.sale_price: $48.5 million (summer 2026; buyer a private individual, not recorded)

citation.label: The San Francisco Standard, “New landlord, new leggings: Alo Yoga is on its way to a Union Square store,” 19 November 2026

raw.text: The company filed permits Tuesday to alter the exteriors of 170 and 180 Post St. for the new location.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 180 POST ST → parcel 0293007; sf-parcels has blklot 0293007 active, 206–214 GRANT; the 2025 roll records it as commercial retail, built 1908. EAS puts 170, 180, 190 POST ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 170.

publish.note: Entry on /san-francisco/financial-district/post-street/170/ (170, 180 and 190 Post share one parcel); dated the Tuesday the permits were filed. The building's buyer is a private individual and is not recorded; the store is a plan, so nothing goes into building.
